desc.zh: 倒序补砖，用屋顶连通数的增量推导掉落数量。
desc.en: Reverse the hits and derive fallen counts from growth in roof connectivity.

complexity: O((mn + H) α(mn)) amortized time; O(mn + H) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Reverse connectivity
concepts.description: Restore erased bricks and measure growth of the roof-connected component.

concepts.name: Union-find component sizes
concepts.description: Maintain roof component size by path halving and union by size.
